title: The gallery key
body: The gallery key is wrapped in a request to protect the collection; the handover form says the building was secure before the key was returned.
rival_reading: A preservation team could have secured the room against any hazard; the form does not show who checked it.
gloss: A secure-building handover is recorded before the key returns.

cites.quote: Whoever finds this, I was Natalie Sigmundsson
